name: obsidian-link-integrity
description: Continuously find broken internal links and isolated files across an Obsidian Vault.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:bundle && npm run check:release
scripts.lint: eslint main.ts src tests benchmarks scripts esbuild.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.mts --max-warnings 0
scripts.check: npm run check:runtime && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:readme-i18n && npm run check:docs-i18n && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build:bundle && npm run check:release
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run bench:index && npm run bench:index:large
